sentences.full_sentence: GNR found an elderly woman reported missing in the village of Vila Real
This afternoon, the GNR found the 81-year-old woman who had been missing since Monday in Sabroso, in the municipality of Vila Real, a source from that police force said today.
The octogenarian was detected by a dog from the GNR dog team about two kilometers from her residence and was transported to the Vila Real unit of the Trás-os-Montes and Alto Douro Hospital Center.

sentences.full_sentence: The alert for the disappearance of the elderly woman, who lives with a family member, was given at 5pm on Monday, having been searched for by members of the GNR's Emergency Protection and Relief Unit (UEPS) during the night.

sentences.full_sentence: The searches were resumed this morning, involving members of the GNR and firefighters, and the woman was found at 3:40 pm.
According to the website of the National Emergency and Civil Protection Authority, 29 officers and nine vehicles were mobilized for this incident.
